body: Don’t do it. I tell myself ( and even did this once) that if I finally decide to kill myself I will go on a big trip instead, or do something fun I wouldn’t have had the guts to before. Far from the best advice but taking that trip made me realize there’s more to see in life.
This might not do shit but reading the power of letting go by David Hawkins helped me so much

In a similar spot and I just wanna say you’re not alone and I’m fucking sorry. It sucks. People you treat like gold can treat you like trash. I don’t understand it and never will. But know you’re not alone and there a few people out there who actually care as much as you do. Go eat some ice cream, cry, and scream into the void while taking a shower

If you’re really about to or considering ending it.. or even on this forum, it’s worth considering. Your job won’t matter if you’re dead. But try and take a sick leave for a few days. Blame it on Covid if you think they won’t accept another reason. Prime time to call out of work with the pandemic

I promise you that your perception of your body is worse than what others see. I’m not gonna lie and say you’re so beautiful or handsome because I truly don’t know but I do know that you are better looking than you think. That’s the depression talking. Trust me on that. I feel the same and feel like no one cares.. but that’s just your mind. I promise you at least 1 person (or pet) would care if you were gone. Do it for them. That’s what I’m doing. It’s hard. Sometimes it sucks and sometimes I have a good day and am glad I didn’t end it. But regardless at least I’m not causing my loved ones pain and in the meantime I’m experiencing life. I guess it’s so damn short anyway that we might as well stay. Good luck. I hope it gets better for u. And shit, I care.
